description: Complete graph-route recovery, graph latent drifting, decode-validity, and SELFIES fairness package.

resource_policy.reason: GPU2 is idle; the graph route is now treated as a required reviewer-facing experiment chain rather than a diagnostic note.
resource_policy.checkpoint_policy: Keep best.pt/final_metrics.json/resolved_config.json; delete completed last.pt files only after their final metrics and best checkpoint are confirmed.

preconditions: Rebuild archive/graph_vae_line/data/qm9/qm9_from_cache.smi and archive/graph_vae_line/data/cache/qm9_graph_cache.pt from the recovered QM9 SMILES list.
Train archive/graph_vae_line/outputs/vae_v3_valence/best.pt with the recovered graph cache.
Rebuild archive/graph_vae_line/data/cache/qm9_latent_cache_v3.pt from the recovered VAE checkpoint.
Require scripts/audit_graph_archive_launchability.py complete=true before launching fresh graph latent drifting rows.
